gloss: the core celebratory dishes served at New Year

definitions.gloss: the core celebratory dishes served at New Year
definitions.explanation: The small auspicious dishes that open an osechi box, above all the {三種|さんしゅ} (three kinds): black soybeans, candied sardines, and herring roe. Tradition holds that these three plus rice cakes are enough to celebrate the New Year properly.

examples.japanese: {祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}{三種|さんしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧だ。
examples.english: The three celebratory dishes are the basis of osechi.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関東|かんとう}→関東：00186_kantou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}{三種|さんしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦{異|こと}なっている→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The contents of the three celebratory dishes differ in part between the Kanto and Kansai regions.

notes:
Here ⟦{肴|さかな}→肴：13929_sakana⟧ means a dish eaten with sake, not fish; the reading voices to ざかな in the compound.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}{三種|さんしゅ}: the three celebratory dishes
- {祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare the celebratory dishes
- ⟦おせち→おせち：09649_osechi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝|いわ}い{肴|ざかな}: the celebratory dishes in an osechi box

CULTURAL NOTE:
In the Kanto region the three are ⟦{黒豆|くろまめ}→黒豆：30552_kuromame⟧, ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧, and ⟦{田作|たづく}り→田作り：30553_tazukuri⟧; in Kansai ⟦{田作|たづく}り→田作り：30553_tazukuri⟧ is commonly replaced by ⟦たたきごぼう→たたきごぼう：30559_tatakigobou⟧.
